d:
Uruguay pulled off a MASSIVE upset against Canada in the FIBA Basketball World Cup 2027 Americas Qualifiers, handing the Canadians their FIRST LOSS of the entire qualifying campaign!
Playing in front of their home fans in Montevideo, Uruguay delivered an incredible team performance, showing no fear against one of the strongest teams in the Americas!
Santiago Vescovi led the way with 17 POINTS, while Joaquin Rodriguez added 16 points and 8 assists to help Uruguay secure a HUGE victory!
